name: com.gpufindr/gpu-finder
title: GPU Finder
description: Live cloud GPU rental prices from a dozen providers. Search by GPU model, price and score.

tools.name: fetch_gpu
tools.description: Get the full record of one GPU rental offer by its id, as returned by search_gpus.

id.description: Offer id from a search_gpus result.

tools.name: search_gpus
tools.description: Search live cloud GPU rental offers from about a dozen providers (Vast.ai, RunPod, Lambda, Akash, Lium and others), refreshed at least every two hours. Use it to find the cheapest or best-value GPU for a workload, or to compare prices for a GPU model across providers. Returns a count of matching offers and a JSON array; each offer has id, name, num_gpus, vram_mb, total_cost_ph (USD per hour for the whole offer), location, source (provider), reliability, CPU, RAM, disk and network details, and score.

max_price.description: Maximum total_cost_ph in USD per hour. Omit, 0 or -1 for no limit.

min_score.description: Minimum score, 0 to 100, combining GPU compute, memory bandwidth, VRAM, GPU count, reliability, CPU and RAM. Omit or 0 for any.

offset.description: Number of matching offers to skip, for paging (default 0).

order_by.description: Sort as column.direction. total_cost_ph.asc is cheapest first, score.desc is most capable first, score_dollar_ph.desc is best score per dollar. Default updated_at.desc.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the GPU model name, e.g. "H100", "A100", "4090". Omit or "*" for any model.

region.description: Exact match on the offer's location field; formats vary by provider (e.g. "California, US", "us-southeast-1"). Omit or "*" for any location.
